newsitem.title: UK: Boots rallies after special dividend.
newsitem.headline: Boots rallies after special dividend.

text.p: Shares in high street chemist Boots Co Plc rallied from an early decline by midsession on Thursday, as investors welcomed the company's results and special dividend, dealers said.

The stock was down just 9p at 685-1/2 by 1119 GMT in volume of 4.2 million shares but after stripping out the effect of the loss of the special dividend worth 44.2p per share, the shares were up sharply on the day.
Earlier, Boots shares fell 34-1/2p in a mark-down after it went ex- the special payout, worth a total 400 million stg.
"The stock has responded well to the special dividend," said one dealer. "At least they are not spending the money unwisely, they are giving it back to their shareholders."

Dealers said the stock had also been lifted by the company's year-end results, showing a nine percent rise in pre-tax, pre-exceptional profits to 536 million stg, at the top end of the range of analyst forecasts.
"The figures were quite good and some buyers came in," said one market-maker.
